episodeTitle.en: Pricing your AI product: Lessons from 400+ companies and 50 unicorns | Madhavan Ramanujam
episodeTitle.zh: 《为AI产品定价：400+家公司与50家独角兽的经验之谈 | 马德哈万·拉马努贾姆》

guestBioOfficial.en: Madhavan Ramanujam is the world’s foremost expert on pricing and monetization strategy. As managing partner at Simon-Kucher, he helped over 250 companies, including 30 unicorns, architect their pricing strategies. He’s the author of the definitive book on pricing, Monetizing Innovation. Now he’s back with a sequel, Scaling Innovation, which reveals how to build enduring businesses by dominating both market share and wallet share. He recently left Simon-Kucher to launch his own fund, 49 Palms, focused on helping early-stage AI companies. *In this conversation, we discuss:*
guestBioOfficial.zh: 马德哈万·拉马努贾姆是全球定价与货币化策略领域的顶尖专家。作为西蒙-库彻管理合伙人，他曾为包括30家独角兽在内的250多家公司设计定价策略。他是定价领域权威著作《货币化创新》的作者，如今他推出续作《扩展创新》，揭示如何通过主导市场份额与用户忠诚度双重优势打造持久商业帝国。他近期离开西蒙-库彻，创立专注于助力早期AI公司的基金49 Palms。*在本次对话中，我们将探讨：*

title.en: Pricing your AI product: Lessons from 400+ companies and 50 unicorns | Madhavan Ramanujam
title.zh: 《为AI产品定价：400+家公司与50家独角兽的经验之谈 | 马德哈万·拉马努贾姆》

summary.en: Madhavan argues that in the AI era, winners must master monetization from day one and resist anchoring customers on low price points like $20/month, because 20% of what you build drives 80% of willingness to pay. He introduces a simple two-by-two for picking a pricing model and explains why the coveted top-right quadrant is true outcome-based pricing, where you have both autonomy and attribution. The conversation covers how to gain pricing power, tactical negotiation advice, and the most common traps founders fall into that prevent durable, profitable businesses. He stresses that great founders must dominate both market share and wallet share—and that getting pricing right early is far cheaper than fixing it later.
summary.zh: Madhavan 认为，在 AI 时代，赢家必须从第一天起就精通变现，不能把客户锚定在每月 20 美元这样的低价上，因为你构建的东西里，有 20% 决定了 80% 的支付意愿。他介绍了一个用来选择定价模型的简单四象限，并解释了为什么大家都想要的那个右上角，是真正的“基于结果的定价”——既拥有自主权，又能清晰归因。对话涵盖了如何获得定价权、具体的谈判建议，以及创始人最常掉进去、导致无法建立持久盈利业务的那些陷阱。他强调，优秀的创始人必须同时拿下市场份额和钱包份额，而且尽早把定价做对，远比日后返工便宜得多。
